name: How long does a low threshold shower installation project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a low threshold shower installation project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard low threshold shower installation typically takes 1 to 3 weeks to complete, from initial demolition to final touches. This timeline includes preparing the subfloor, ensuring proper drainage and waterproofing, installing new plumbing if necessary, tiling, and setting the glass enclosure. The duration can be influenced by the scope of work, material availability, and whether existing plumbing needs significant relocation. We aim to minimize disruption while ensuring a high-quality, durable installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most low threshold shower installations take 1 to 3 weeks. This includes demolition, subfloor preparation, waterproofing, tiling, and glass enclosure installation.
